description: 查詢某個 Library/Object 目前是否被鎖定，可依鎖定類型/持有工作反查

params.name: library
params.prompt: 請輸入 Library 名稱

params.name: object
params.prompt: 請輸入 Object 名稱

params.name: objectType
params.prompt: 限定物件類型(OBJECT_TYPE)，例如 *FILE，留空不篩選

params.name: lockState
params.prompt: 限定鎖定類型

params.name: jobName
params.prompt: 反查：限定持有鎖定的工作名稱

params.name: jobUser
params.prompt: 反查：限定持有鎖定的使用者

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_LOCK_INFO WHERE SYSTEM_OBJECT_SCHEMA = '{library}' AND SYSTEM_OBJECT_NAME = '{object}' AND (OBJECT_TYPE = '{objectType}' OR '{objectType}' = '') AND (LOCK_STATE = '{lockState}' OR '{lockState}' = '') AND (JOB_NAME = '{jobName}' OR '{jobName}' = '') AND (JOB_USER = '{jobUser}' OR '{jobUser}' = '') ORDER BY LOCK_STATE

description: 反查某個工作(job)目前鎖定或持有哪些物件的鎖定

params.name: jobName
params.prompt: 請輸入完整合格工作名稱(格式: 工作編號/使用者/工作名稱)，或輸入 * 查詢目前工作

params.name: internalObjects
params.prompt: 是否包含內部系統物件

params.name: lockCategory
params.prompt: 限定鎖定實體類型

params.name: lockState
params.prompt: 限定鎖定類型

params.name: objectLibrary
params.prompt: 限定物件所在Library，留空不篩選

params.name: objectName
params.prompt: 限定物件名稱，留空不篩選

params.name: ignoreErrors
params.prompt: 遇錯誤時的處理方式(YES=回傳警告且不回傳該列，官方預設；NO=直接回傳錯誤)

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE (QSYS2.JOB_LOCK_INFO(JOB_NAME => '{jobName}', INTERNAL_OBJECTS => '{internalObjects}', IGNORE_ERRORS => '{ignoreErrors}')) X WHERE (LOCK_CATEGORY = '{lockCategory}' OR '{lockCategory}' = '') AND (LOCK_STATE = '{lockState}' OR '{lockState}' = '') AND (OBJECT_LIBRARY = '{objectLibrary}' OR '{objectLibrary}' = '') AND (OBJECT_NAME = '{objectName}' OR '{objectName}' = '') ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME

description: 查詢資料表記錄(record)層級的鎖定狀態，可依Library/資料表/鎖定類型/持有工作篩選

params.name: library
params.prompt: 限定 Library 名稱，留空查詢全系統

params.name: table
params.prompt: 限定資料表名稱，留空查詢全部資料表

params.name: lockState
params.prompt: 限定鎖定類型

params.name: jobName
params.prompt: 反查：限定持有鎖定的工作名稱

params.name: jobUser
params.prompt: 反查：限定持有鎖定的使用者

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM QSYS2.RECORD_LOCK_INFO WHERE (SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = '{library}' OR '{library}' = '') AND (SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = '{table}' OR '{table}' = '') AND (LOCK_STATE = '{lockState}' OR '{lockState}' = '') AND (JOB_NAME = '{jobName}' OR '{jobName}' = '') AND (JOB_USER = '{jobUser}' OR '{jobUser}' = '') ORDER BY JOB_NAME

description: 將NVMe裝置加入密碼鎖定原則

params.name: policyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入鎖定原則密碼(16-32字元)

params.name: resourceName
params.prompt: 請輸入要加入的NVMe裝置資源名稱，或輸入 *ALL 套用全部符合資格的裝置

sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.ADD_DEVICE_LOCKING_POLICY(POLICY_PASSWORD => '{policyPassword}', RESOURCE_NAME => '{resourceName}')

description: 變更NVMe硬碟鎖定原則的密碼

params.name: policyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入目前的鎖定原則密碼

params.name: newPolicyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入新的鎖定原則密碼(16-32字元)

sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.CHANGE_DEVICE_LOCKING_POLICY(POLICY_PASSWORD => '{policyPassword}', NEW_POLICY_PASSWORD => '{newPolicyPassword}')

description: 同步NVMe裝置密碼與Platform KeyStore(FIXUP)，用於 QSYS2.LOCKING_POLICY_INFO 的 PASSWORD_FIXUP_REQUIRED 顯示YES時修復
sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.CHANGE_DEVICE_LOCKING_POLICY(FIXUP => 'YES')

description: 建立NVMe硬碟密碼鎖定原則

params.name: policyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入初始鎖定原則密碼(16-32字元)

sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.CREATE_LOCKING_POLICY(POLICY_PASSWORD => '{policyPassword}')

description: 刪除NVMe硬碟密碼鎖定原則(從所有裝置移除)

params.name: policyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入目前的鎖定原則密碼

sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.DELETE_LOCKING_POLICY(POLICY_PASSWORD => '{policyPassword}')

description: 將NVMe裝置從密碼鎖定原則中移除

params.name: policyPassword
params.prompt: 請輸入目前的鎖定原則密碼

params.name: resourceName
params.prompt: 請輸入要移除的NVMe裝置資源名稱

sqlTemplate: CALL QSYS2.REMOVE_DEVICE_LOCKING_POLICY(POLICY_PASSWORD => '{policyPassword}', RESOURCE_NAME => '{resourceName}')

description: 查詢NVMe裝置目前的鎖定原則狀態，可依裝置資源名稱/是否已加入原則/是否需要密碼同步篩選

params.name: resourceName
params.prompt: 限定裝置資源名稱，留空查詢全部

params.name: underPolicy
params.prompt: 是否已加入鎖定原則

params.name: lockState
params.prompt: 鎖定狀態(依官方文件定義)

params.name: passwordFixupRequired
params.prompt: 是否需要密碼同步(FIXUP)

sqlTemplate: SELECT RESOURCE_NAME, SERIAL_NUMBER, TYPE, LOCKING_SUPPORTED, ELIGIBLE_POLICY, UNDER_POLICY, LOCK_STATE, UNLOCK_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED, PASSWORD_FIXUP_REQUIRED FROM QSYS2.LOCKING_POLICY_INFO WHERE (RESOURCE_NAME = '{resourceName}' OR '{resourceName}' = '') AND (UNDER_POLICY = '{underPolicy}' OR '{underPolicy}' = '') AND (LOCK_STATE = '{lockState}' OR '{lockState}' = '') AND (PASSWORD_FIXUP_REQUIRED = '{passwordFixupRequired}' OR '{passwordFixupRequired}' = '')

description: 查詢資料表大小，可依Library/資料表名稱/最少筆數/大小門檻篩選

params.name: library
params.prompt: 限定 Library 名稱，留空查詢全系統

params.name: tableName
params.prompt: 限定資料表名稱，留空查詢全部資料表

params.name: minSizeMb
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(MB)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

params.name: minRows
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(最少筆數)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

sqlTemplate: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, NUMBER_ROWS, DATA_SIZE FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLESTAT WHERE (TABLE_SCHEMA = '{library}' OR '{library}' = '') AND (TABLE_NAME = '{tableName}' OR '{tableName}' = '') AND (DATA_SIZE > {minSizeMb} * 1024 * 1024 OR '{minSizeMb}' = '0') AND (NUMBER_ROWS >= {minRows} OR '{minRows}' = '0') ORDER BY DATA_SIZE DESC

description: 查詢某個 IFS 目錄下超過指定大小(MB)的檔案

params.name: path
params.prompt: 請輸入起始 IFS 路徑 (例如 /home，大小寫皆可)

params.name: minSizeMb
params.prompt: 請輸入篩選門檻(MB)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

params.name: subtreeDirectories
params.prompt: 是否遞迴搜尋子目錄，官方預設YES

params.name: objectTypeList
params.prompt: 限定物件類型(用空白分隔多個類型，如*STMF *DIR)，留空(*ALL相當)不篩選

params.name: omitList
params.prompt: 要排除的路徑(用空白分隔多個路徑)，留空不排除

params.name: ignoreErrors
params.prompt: 遇錯誤時的處理方式(YES=回傳警告且不回傳該列，官方預設；NO=直接回傳錯誤)

sqlTemplate: SELECT PATH_NAME, DATA_SIZE FROM TABLE (QSYS2.IFS_OBJECT_STATISTICS(START_PATH_NAME => '{path}', SUBTREE_DIRECTORIES => '{subtreeDirectories}', OBJECT_TYPE_LIST => '{objectTypeList}', OMIT_LIST => '{omitList}', IGNORE_ERRORS => '{ignoreErrors}')) X WHERE DATA_SIZE > {minSizeMb} * 1024 * 1024 ORDER BY DATA_SIZE DESC

description: 查詢Library內物件明細，可依物件類型/名稱/大小門檻篩選，找出佔用空間過大的物件

params.name: objectSchema
params.prompt: 限定Library名稱，可用特殊值 *ALLUSR(所有使用者Library)/*ALL/*CURLIB/*LIBL 等

params.name: objectTypeList
params.prompt: 限定物件類型，例如 *FILE *PGM，留空(*ALL)查全部類型

params.name: objectName
params.prompt: 限定物件名稱(可用萬用字元*結尾)，留空查全部

params.name: minSizeMb
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(MB)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE (QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(OBJECT_SCHEMA => '{objectSchema}', OBJTYPELIST => '{objectTypeList}', OBJECT_NAME => '{objectName}')) X WHERE (OBJSIZE > {minSizeMb} * 1024 * 1024 OR '{minSizeMb}' = '0') ORDER BY OBJSIZE DESC

description: 查詢備份檔(Save File)清單，可依所在Library/來源Library篩選

params.name: saveFileLibrary
params.prompt: 限定備份檔所在Library，留空不篩選

params.name: libraryName
params.prompt: 限定備份來源Library，留空不篩選

sqlTemplate: SELECT SAVE_FILE_LIBRARY, SAVE_FILE, SAVE_TIMESTAMP, OBJECTS_SAVED, DATA_COMPRESSED FROM QSYS2.SAVE_FILE_INFO WHERE (SAVE_FILE_LIBRARY = '{saveFileLibrary}' OR '{saveFileLibrary}' = '') AND (LIBRARY_NAME = '{libraryName}' OR '{libraryName}' = '') ORDER BY SAVE_TIMESTAMP DESC

description: 查詢指定備份檔(Save File)內含的物件清單，可依物件名稱/類型篩選

params.name: saveFile
params.prompt: 請輸入備份檔(Save File)名稱

params.name: saveFileLibrary
params.prompt: 請輸入備份檔所在Library

params.name: objectNameFilter
params.prompt: 限定物件名稱(可用萬用字元*結尾)，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: objectTypeFilter
params.prompt: 限定物件類型，留空(*ALL)查全部類型

params.name: detailedInfo
params.prompt: 詳細資訊層級

params.name: ignoreErrors
params.prompt: 遇錯誤時的處理方式(YES=回傳警告且不回傳該列，官方預設；NO=直接回傳錯誤)

sqlTemplate: SELECT LIBRARY_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, SAVE_TIMESTAMP, OBJECT_SIZE FROM TABLE (QSYS2.SAVE_FILE_OBJECTS(SAVE_FILE => '{saveFile}', SAVE_FILE_LIBRARY => '{saveFileLibrary}', OBJECT_NAME_FILTER => '{objectNameFilter}', OBJECT_TYPE_FILTER => '{objectTypeFilter}', DETAILED_INFO => '{detailedInfo}', IGNORE_ERRORS => '{ignoreErrors}')) X ORDER BY OBJECT_SIZE DESC

description: 查詢磁碟機使用率與健康狀態，可依使用率門檻/硬體狀態/ASP編號篩選

params.name: minPercentUsed
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(使用率% 以上)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

params.name: hardwareStatus
params.prompt: 限定硬體狀態

params.name: aspNumber
params.prompt: 限定ASP編號，留空不篩選

params.name: resetStatistics
params.prompt: 是否重設統計基準點

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE (QSYS2.SYSDISKSTAT(RESET_STATISTICS => '{resetStatistics}')) X WHERE (PERCENT_USED >= {minPercentUsed} OR '{minPercentUsed}' = '0') AND (HARDWARE_STATUS = '{hardwareStatus}' OR '{hardwareStatus}' = '') AND (CHAR(ASP_NUMBER) = '{aspNumber}' OR '{aspNumber}' = '') ORDER BY PERCENT_USED DESC

description: 查詢作用中工作的CPU使用狀況，可依副系統/工作名稱/使用者/CPU使用率門檻篩選

params.name: subsystem
params.prompt: 副系統名稱(SUBSYSTEM)，留空查詢全部副系統

params.name: jobName
params.prompt: 工作名稱，留空查詢全部工作

params.name: currentUser
params.prompt: 目前使用者(CURRENT_USER)，留空查詢全部使用者

params.name: detailedInfo
params.prompt: 詳細程度

params.name: minCpuPercent
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(CPU使用率% 以上)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

params.name: resetStatistics
params.prompt: 是否重設統計基準點(等同WRKACTJOB F10)，官方預設NO

sqlTemplate: SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, SUBSYSTEM, CPU_TIME, ELAPSED_CPU_PERCENTAGE FROM TABLE (QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO(RESET_STATISTICS => '{resetStatistics}', SUBSYSTEM_LIST_FILTER => '{subsystem}', JOB_NAME_FILTER => '{jobName}', CURRENT_USER_LIST_FILTER => '{currentUser}', DETAILED_INFO => '{detailedInfo}')) X WHERE (ELAPSED_CPU_PERCENTAGE >= {minCpuPercent} OR '{minCpuPercent}' = '0') ORDER BY CPU_TIME DESC

description: 查詢系統整體效能狀態(CPU/工作數/記憶體/ASP使用率)
sqlTemplate: SELECT TOTAL_JOBS_IN_SYSTEM, MAXIMUM_JOBS_IN_SYSTEM, ACTIVE_JOBS_IN_SYSTEM, CONFIGURED_CPUS, AVERAGE_CPU_RATE, MAIN_STORAGE_SIZE, SYSTEM_ASP_USED, TOTAL_AUXILIARY_STORAGE FROM QSYS2.SYSTEM_STATUS_INFO

description: 查詢日誌(Journal)設定與掛接的接收者，可依程式庫/日誌名稱/接收者/訊息佇列篩選

params.name: library
params.prompt: 限定 Library 名稱，留空查詢全系統

params.name: journalName
params.prompt: 限定日誌(Journal)名稱，留空查詢全部日誌

params.name: receiverName
params.prompt: 限定日誌接收者(RECEIVER)名稱，留空不篩選

params.name: receiverLibrary
params.prompt: 限定日誌接收者所在Library，留空不篩選

params.name: messageQueue
params.prompt: 限定訊息佇列名稱，留空不篩選

params.name: messageQueueLibrary
params.prompt: 限定訊息佇列所在Library，留空不篩選

sqlTemplate: SELECT JOURNAL_NAME, JOURNAL_LIBRARY, ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_NAME, ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY, MESSAGE_QUEUE, MESSAGE_QUEUE_LIBRARY FROM QSYS2.JOURNAL_INFO WHERE (JOURNAL_LIBRARY = '{library}' OR '{library}' = '') AND (JOURNAL_NAME = '{journalName}' OR '{journalName}' = '') AND (ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_NAME = '{receiverName}' OR '{receiverName}' = '') AND (ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY = '{receiverLibrary}' OR '{receiverLibrary}' = '') AND (MESSAGE_QUEUE = '{messageQueue}' OR '{messageQueue}' = '') AND (MESSAGE_QUEUE_LIBRARY = '{messageQueueLibrary}' OR '{messageQueueLibrary}' = '')

description: 重新關聯日誌接收者與日誌，修復association異常

params.name: journalLibrary
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌所在Library

params.name: journalName
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌名稱

params.name: receiverLibrary
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌接收者所在Library

params.name: receiverName
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌接收者名稱，可用萬用字元*結尾或*ALL

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ASSOCIATE_JOURNAL_RECEIVER('{journalLibrary}', '{journalName}', '{receiverLibrary}', '{receiverName}'))

description: 查詢稽核日誌資料超市(data mart)的建置狀態，可依Library/項目類型/只看失敗篩選

params.name: dataMartLibrary
params.prompt: 限定資料超市所在Library，留空不篩選

params.name: journalEntryType
params.prompt: 限定稽核項目類型(例如PW)，留空不篩選

params.name: onlyFailures
params.prompt: 只看建置失敗的紀錄

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM QSYS2.AUDIT_JOURNAL_DATA_MART_INFO WHERE (DATA_MART_LIBRARY = '{dataMartLibrary}' OR '{dataMartLibrary}' = '') AND (JOURNAL_ENTRY_TYPE = '{journalEntryType}' OR '{journalEntryType}' = '') AND (FAILURE_DETAIL IS NOT NULL OR '{onlyFailures}' = 'NO')

description: 查詢交易確認定義(commitment definition)狀態，可依工作/LUW狀態/是否有未確認異動篩選

params.name: jobName
params.prompt: 限定工作名稱，留空不篩選

params.name: luwState
params.prompt: 限定LUW狀態

params.name: onlyPending
params.prompt: 只看有未確認(pending)本地異動的工作

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM QSYS2.DB_TRANSACTION_INFO WHERE (JOB_NAME = '{jobName}' OR '{jobName}' = '') AND (LOGICAL_UNIT_OF_WORK_STATE = '{luwState}' OR '{luwState}' = '') AND (LOCAL_CHANGES_PENDING = 'YES' OR '{onlyPending}' = 'NO')

description: 查詢指定交易(lock space id)的日誌資源認可/回復進度

params.name: lockSpaceId
params.prompt: 請輸入交易的lock space id

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DB_TRANSACTION_JOURNAL_INFO('{lockSpaceId}'))

description: 查詢指定交易(lock space id)下異動過的物件清單

params.name: lockSpaceId
params.prompt: 請輸入交易的lock space id

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DB_TRANSACTION_OBJECT_INFO('{lockSpaceId}')) ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

description: 查詢指定交易(lock space id)下資料庫檔案的記錄層級認可/回復狀態

params.name: lockSpaceId
params.prompt: 請輸入交易的lock space id

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DB_TRANSACTION_RECORD_INFO('{lockSpaceId}'))

description: 查詢日誌項目內容(等同SQL版DSPJRN)，可依時間範圍/物件/使用者/工作/程式/代碼與類型篩選

params.name: journalLibrary
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌所在Library

params.name: journalName
params.prompt: 請輸入日誌名稱

params.name: startingTimestamp
params.prompt: 只看此時間點之後的項目，留空=從最早開始

params.name: endingTimestamp
params.prompt: 只看此時間點之前的項目，留空=到目前為止

params.name: journalCodes
params.prompt: 限定日誌代碼，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: journalEntryTypes
params.prompt: 限定日誌項目類型，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: objectLibrary
params.prompt: 限定物件所在Library，留空不篩選

params.name: objectName
params.prompt: 限定物件名稱，留空(*ALLFILE)不篩選

params.name: objectType
params.prompt: 限定物件類型

params.name: user
params.prompt: 限定使用者，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: job
params.prompt: 限定工作，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: program
params.prompt: 限定程式，留空(*ALL)查全部

params.name: startingReceiverLibrary
params.prompt: 起始日誌接收者所在Library，留空使用*CURRENT(官方預設)

params.name: startingReceiverName
params.prompt: 起始日誌接收者名稱，可用*CURRENT/*CURCHAIN/*CURAVLCHN/*CURSEQCHN特殊值，留空使用*CURRENT(官方預設)

params.name: startingSequence
params.prompt: 起始序號(跟起始時間擇一，不可同時指定)，留空不篩選

params.name: objectMember
params.prompt: 限定成員名稱，可用*FIRST/*ALL/*NONE特殊值，留空不篩選

params.name: endingReceiverLibrary
params.prompt: 結束日誌接收者所在Library，留空使用*CURRENT(官方預設)

params.name: endingReceiverName
params.prompt: 結束日誌接收者名稱，留空使用*CURRENT(官方預設)

params.name: endingSequence
params.prompt: 結束序號(跟結束時間擇一，不可同時指定)，留空不篩選

params.name: generateSyslog
params.prompt: 轉換為syslog格式，只對稽核日誌(QSYS/QAUDJRN)有效，留空(NO)不轉換

params.name: eofDelay
params.prompt: 輪詢間隔秒數(留空/0=不輪詢)。官方限制：>0時generate-syslog必須指定RFC3164/RFC5424，且會忽略ending-receiver/ending-sequence，並且不能搭配ORDER BY——這裡若填>0請自行從產生的SQL移除ORDER BY

params.name: commitCycle
params.prompt: 限定交易(commit cycle)識別碼，留空(*ALL)不篩選

params.name: includeInternal
params.prompt: 是否包含系統內部產生的隱藏日誌項目

sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM TABLE (QSYS2.DISPLAY_JOURNAL(JOURNAL_LIBRARY => '{journalLibrary}', JOURNAL_NAME => '{journalName}', STARTING_RECEIVER_LIBRARY => '{startingReceiverLibrary}', STARTING_RECEIVER_NAME => '{startingReceiverName}', STARTING_TIMESTAMP => {startingTimestamp}, STARTING_SEQUENCE => CASE WHEN '{startingSequence}' = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST('{startingSequence}' AS DECIMAL(21,0)) END, JOURNAL_CODES => '{journalCodes}', JOURNAL_ENTRY_TYPES => '{journalEntryTypes}', OBJECT_LIBRARY => '{objectLibrary}', OBJECT_NAME => '{objectName}', OBJECT_OBJTYPE => '{objectType}', OBJECT_MEMBER => NULLIF('{objectMember}', ''), USER => '{user}', JOB => '{job}', PROGRAM => '{program}', ENDING_RECEIVER_LIBRARY => '{endingReceiverLibrary}', ENDING_RECEIVER_NAME => '{endingReceiverName}', ENDING_TIMESTAMP => {endingTimestamp}, ENDING_SEQUENCE => CASE WHEN '{endingSequence}' = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST('{endingSequence}' AS DECIMAL(21,0)) END, GENERATE_SYSLOG => '{generateSyslog}', EOF_DELAY => {eofDelay}, COMMIT_CYCLE => CASE WHEN '{commitCycle}' = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST('{commitCycle}' AS DECIMAL(21,0)) END, INCLUDE_INTERNAL => '{includeInternal}')) X ORDER BY ENTRY_TIMESTAMP

description: 查詢系統歷程紀錄(等同SQL版DSPLOG)，可依時間範圍/訊息類型/嚴重度門檻篩選

params.name: startTime
params.prompt: 起始時間，留空=昨天(官方預設CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY)

params.name: endTime
params.prompt: 結束時間，留空=到目前為止

params.name: messageType
params.prompt: 限定訊息類型

params.name: minSeverity
params.prompt: 篩選門檻(嚴重度 至少)，直接按 Enter 使用預設值

params.name: generateSyslog
params.prompt: 轉換為syslog格式(RFC3164/RFC5424)，留空(NO)不轉換
